I guess the Korblox Empire didn't learn from last year. We've received reports that they're back and stronger than ever.
I have to say, it looks like they've renovated the place!
We're in their territory now, so I recommend upgrading the towers for some Hidden detection.
Brace yourself! They're much more aggressive than last time!
Look out! The Korblox Warriors have returned!
Man they're tough! We'll need to bring out the big guns!
These Redcliff Traitors never cease to amaze me.
Let's give these things what they deserve!
Wait a minute... are those Fallen?!
When did they team up with the Korblox Empire?!

Be on your guard--I can bet that there's more to their strategy than what we can see.
It's terrifying how well the Fallen and Korblox Empire can work together.
Just how long have they been planning this attack?
Keep your eyes peeled! I doubt we're through the worst of it.
I can't shake the feeling that something's watching us! Whatever it is, prepare for the worst!
It's all or nothing. Let's end this!
